headline: Fresh Assaults Stir Six Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Marban Hollow has become the liveliest immediate flashpoint, recording seven events in the latest two hours and 30 during the day, while Checkpoint Bua accounts for 21 of them. Olavis Wake has also quickened, with five fresh events and 30 over 24 hours; Koskinla leads that unsettled sector with ten. Weathered Expanse remains the broadest contest, posting four recent events and 55 for the day amid three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Kuura Strand has added two latest-window events and now shows four in six hours, with its six bases divided among Wardens, Colonials, and no-man’s-land. Pari Peak remains active with one new event, five in six hours, and 27 across the day. Linn Mercy has gone quiet in the latest two hours but still carries 18 daily events, concentrated at Outwich Ranch. Elsewhere, Nevish Line has no fresh action after four events in six hours, while Gutter and the settled districts show little immediate movement. The packet therefore points to a narrow band of contested fronts rather than a general advance.
